title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

statement.hi: Ek badhte order ka sorted array (saare elements alag) `1` se `n` baar rotate kiya gaya hai, jaise `[0,1,2,4,5,6,7]` → `[4,5,6,7,0,1,2]`. Rotated array `nums` me se **minimum** element return karo. O(log n) me karo.
statement.en: An ascending sorted array of distinct elements has been rotated between `1` and `n` times, e.g. `[0,1,2,4,5,6,7]` → `[4,5,6,7,0,1,2]`. Given the rotated array `nums`, return its **minimum** element. Solve it in O(log n).

constraints: All integers of nums are unique
nums is sorted and rotated between 1 and n times

hi: Agar `nums[mid] > nums[hi]` to minimum zaroor `mid` ke right me hai; warna `mid` ya uske left me.
en: If `nums[mid] > nums[hi]`, the minimum must be to the right of `mid`; otherwise it is at `mid` or to its left.

explain.hi: Original array [1,2,3,4,5] ko 3 baar rotate kiya gaya.
explain.en: The original array was [1,2,3,4,5] rotated 3 times.

explain.hi: 4 baar rotate kiya — array wahi ka wahi hai.
explain.en: Rotated 4 times — the array is back to its original order.

approach.hi: `lo = 0`, `hi = n-1`, jab tak `lo < hi`: `mid` nikalo. `nums[mid] > nums[hi]` matlab rotation point right me hai → `lo = mid + 1`; warna `hi = mid`. Loop khatam hone pe `nums[lo]` minimum hai. O(log n) time, O(1) space.
approach.en: `lo = 0`, `hi = n-1`, while `lo < hi`: take `mid`. `nums[mid] > nums[hi]` means the rotation point is to the right → `lo = mid + 1`; otherwise `hi = mid`. When the loop ends, `nums[lo]` is the minimum. O(log n) time, O(1) space.
